text.tspan: To take part, place bets in participating Evoplay games and increase your in-game level. Only
real-money bets of €0.10 or more count.
Your player level increases when you earn the required amount of XP (experience points). €1
For each level, you receive crystals that you can use to buy free spins in the in-game shop.
Reaching higher levels unlocks additional benefits.
The promotion runs from 09/21/2026 (00:00 UTC+3) to 11/18/2026 (00:00 UTC+3).
See the in-game menu for the full rules.
